title: The 2018 protests, exile and Nicaragua today
goal: Report what the UN, the IACHR and the government said about Nicaragua since 2018, naming each source, with según and dijo que.
grammar: reported statements and sources: según, dijo que (review)

sections.title: The 2018 protests, exile and Nicaragua today
body: In this lesson you read about the protests of 2018, the exile of writers and the government of Nicaragua today. The text is in Spanish; the screens and instructions are in English. Disputed claims are always given with their source.
The grammar is the one you know for saying who said what: *según* and *dijo que*.

items: I can say who said what, with *según* and *dijo que*.
I can tell what happened in Nicaragua in April 2018, with its sources.
I can say what happened to Sergio Ramírez and Gioconda Belli in 2023.
